2105-5895-6633-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5895-6633-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5895-6633-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2317-3967-6664-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

3752-7046-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
3752-7046-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Iroh.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

4474-4687-5296.notablePrerequisites: Workhorse has at least four counters on it.
4474-4687-5296.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Workhorse, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

851-2557-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Adrix and Nev and Parallel Lives.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
851-2557-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

792-1263-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a mana producing land you control

2092-4954-7677.description:
Activate the land with Shimmerwilds Growth attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Shimmerwilds Growth triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Gruul Turf and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4954-7677.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

647-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-4094-5220-6961-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4094-5220-6961-7396.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

216-1618-2440-2806.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings
216-1618-2440-2806.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
216-1618-2440-2806.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

206-2440-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
206-2440-7082-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

339-677-5147-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4446-5170-5231-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-5170-5231-6132.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

141-2292-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

3532-5078-5901-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2232-3821-6798-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-3821-6798-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

3480-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3480-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

483-2173-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3817-4681-5686.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

225-1315-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-1315-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 9 for each remaining Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1603-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Evil Twin.
372-1603-4681.description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Evil Twin's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Evil Twin ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Evil Twin leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Evil Twin from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3875-5478-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3875-5478-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

801-3156-4763-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Impulsive Pilferer.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, targeting Koll.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1808-2837-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1808-2837-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Resolve the second Eloise trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

828-2445-4613-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Ascendant Spirit does not have summoning sickness and is an Angel.
An opponent cannot block Ascendant Spirit.
828-2445-4613-4762.description:
Activate Ascendant Spirit using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ascendant Spirit using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat three additional times.
Activate Ascendant Spirit's third ability by paying {S}{S}{S}{S}, putting four +1/+1 counters on it and causing it to gain the listed ability.
Repeat until the number of instances of Ascendant Spirit's gained ability is equal to your deck size.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent using Ascendant Spirit.
Ascendant Spirit triggers once for each instance of the gained ability it has, causing you to draw that many cards.

1365-4404-4751-5147.notablePrerequisites: Corridor Monitor and Verduous Gearhulk do not have a -1/-1 counter on them.
1365-4404-4751-5147.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Verdurous Gearhulk and Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk.
When Verdurous Gearhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Corridor Monitor, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

856-1960-2882-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Brandywine Farmer.
You control a Food.
856-1960-2882-5256.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of Brandywine Farmer due to Infinite Reflection.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cauldron Familiar's power.
Repeat for infinite Food tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brandywine Farmer.
When Brandywine Farmer dies, it triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Brandywine Farmer's power.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cauldron Familiar's power.
Repeat from step 10.

2-1651-2499-2593.notablePrerequisites:
Astral Cornucopia has at least four charge counters on it.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Astral Cornucopia minus four.
2-1651-2499-2593.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value less than the number of charge counters on Astral Cornucopia minus four, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

224-1257-1373-3470-4482.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1257-1373-3470-4482.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Lotus Cobra and Retreat to Coralhelm twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve both Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Walking Atlas and choosing either to untap another creature or scry 1.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, giving a creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

988-1211-1371-1771-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Umbris.
Umbris does not have summoning sickness.
988-1211-1371-1771-3851.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Mana Severance.
Resolve each opponent's Mana Severance, searching for and exiling all land cards from their libraries.
Resolve your Mana Severance, choosing not to exile any land cards from your library.
Move to your combat step.
Attack with Umbris.
Umbris triggers, creating a token copy of Umbris for each opponent you have, with each token tapped and attacking a different opponent.
Put all but one Umbris into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Umbris triggers for each Umbris token that enters and each Umbris token triggers for itself and each other Umbris that enters.
Resolve the Umbris triggers, revealing no lands from opponent libraries and exiling each opponent library.

618-2292-2857.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Adarkar Valkyrie with haste.
Tap the Adarkar Valkyrie token targeting Kiki-Jiki.
Sacrifice Kiki-Jiki to Vicera Seer to scry 1.
Adarkar Valkyrie Returns Kiki-Jiki to the battlefield.
Repeat.

101-2665-3617.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
101-2665-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the token Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
